The '''Gungan battle wagon''' was an organically grown vehicle used by the [[Gungan]]s of [[Naboo]] to resupply their artillery pieces with [[booma]]s. One of few land-based vehicles that used wheels instead of [[Repulsorlift|repulsors]], the battle wagon was hauled by powerful [[mammal]]s called [[falumpaset]]s.<ref name="Encyclopedia Starfighters" />
